entities.name: Maga, Traitor to Mortals
entities.description: Wizard of the Minamo on Kamigawa who bonded with the oni and earned the title Traitor to Mortals.

entities.name: Oni
entities.description: Demons Maga studied and bonded with.

events.summary: Maga is caught using the Minamo facilities for foul rites with demons and expelled.
events.quote: until he was caught and expelled by the academy

events.summary: Maga performs a bonding rite with the oni in his own blood and is filled with tarry blackness.
events.quote: the oni poured into his wounds, filling him with tarry blackness, the stain of divine evil

relations.note: Was a wizard of the Minamo before expulsion
relations.quote: was a Wizard from the Minamo on Kamigawa
